title: Signature Sound Garden
concept: A garden with wind chimes, water features, and listening stations — celebrating hearing, aiding auditory rehab. Sound, savored. Concept by Manon.
improvement_over_conventional: Improves on silent clinics with a celebration of hearing.
patient_flow: Patients arrive with hearing loss, sinus misery, or neck lumps; audiometry, endoscopy, and imaging define the problem. Medical management (allergy, hearing aids) comes first; surgical days handle tonsils, sinuses, ears, and thyroids. Cancer patients get multidisciplinary head-and-neck teams; voice and swallowing rehab follows surgery.
code_demo:
# Signature Sound Garden — Signature design prototype
def hearing_loss_class(db_loss):
    """Classifies hearing loss severity from pure-tone average dB HL."""
    if db_loss <= 25: return "Normal hearing"
    if db_loss <= 40: return "Mild loss - consider hearing aids"
    if db_loss <= 70: return "Moderate-severe loss - hearing aids recommended"
    if db_loss <= 90: return "Severe loss - powerful aids or implant eval"
    return "Profound loss - cochlear implant evaluation"
print(hearing_loss_class(65))
teaching: Simple: the core idea in plain words — what it is and why it matters.
